My father has a bachelor's degree, and maybe that’s why I see math as a necessary tool, not a passion. It’s practical for other subjects, but I often need extra help to grasp it.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, especially with complex problems. My low neuroticism helps, but when deadlines loom, I worry about making mistakes. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI chatbots to explain concepts. It was great for step-by-step solutions, but I had to double-check answers. AI helped me understand, not just memorize, which is good. My high conscientiousness made me verify everything, though.
